features.name: Business Central 29 On-Premises Installation
features.description: Full setup process for installing Business Central 2026 release wave 2 on-premises including component selection, service configuration, and database setup.
caveats: DVD should be placed near root drive to avoid long path name errors
Production environments require separate service account (domain account recommended)

features.name: Advanced Installation Option
features.description: Allows selection of specific components to install rather than installing all demo components, suitable for production multi-tier deployments.

features.name: Developer Component Installation
features.description: Installation option that includes AL language extension, service tier, web server, and SQL database components for development environments.
caveats: Does not install VS Code itself, only the extension
For on-premises there is a VSIX package offering

features.name: Service Port Configuration
features.description: Configuration of various service ports including management service port, SOAP web services port, OData service port, and developer service port.
caveats: Developer service port requires explicit specification in VS Code configuration if changed from default 7049
Management service port should be enabled through firewall

features.name: Separate Reporting Services Port
features.description: New in Business Central 29, there is a separate service port specifically for reporting services.

features.name: Authentication Configuration Options
features.description: Multiple authentication methods available including Windows authentication, username-password, and ACS (Azure Cloud Services).

features.name: Snapshot debugging
features.description: Requires a separate port (8083) for debugging functionality during Business Central on-premises installation.

features.name: SQL Server instance configuration
features.description: Installer allows specification of SQL Server instance name, which is optional for default instances but required if a named instance exists.
caveats: requires understanding of SQL instance naming

features.name: Demo database restoration
features.description: Installer restores a demo database with option to customize the database name and replace existing databases if needed.

features.name: Demo license installation
features.description: Option to install a demo license into the Business Central environment during initial setup.

features.name: SOAP and OData web services
features.description: Support for enabling SOAP and OData web services with configurable public URLs during installation.

features.name: IIS web server component
features.description: Automatic installation and configuration of Internet Information Services (IIS) web server component as part of Business Central setup.

features.name: TCP IP port enablement for SQL Server
features.description: Requirement to enable TCP IP protocol on SQL Server for Business Central to communicate with the database; disabled by default in some SQL configurations.
caveats: must be manually enabled if not active

features.name: SQL Server Express version support
features.description: Product DVD includes SQL Server Express as a bundled option for development purposes, installed on a specific instance if not already present.

features.name: Prerequisite components bundling
features.description: Business Central installation includes all required prerequisite components in a dedicated folder, including SQL Server, PowerShell, and other dependencies needed to run Business Central.

features.name: Default Microsoft applications
features.description: Business Central 29 comes with 83 Microsoft-provided apps by default, with variation based on localization selections for watch 2026 release wave 2.

features.name: VS Code AL extension VSIX file
features.description: Product includes a version-specific VSIX file for AL language extension tied to the installed Business Central version, as alternative to marketplace installation.

features.name: System application platform
features.description: System application forms the 2 million series objects that cannot be modified in Business Central; represents the platform foundation separate from the application.

features.name: PowerShell configuration management
features.description: Business Central recommends using PowerShell commands to modify configuration files rather than direct editing of custom settings.

features.name: Service tier configuration files
features.description: Service tier maintains configuration files with database connection details, instance information, port settings, and IIS linking for middle-tier operations.

features.name: NAV settings JSON file
features.description: JSON configuration file that connects the web client to the service tier, containing server instance details, authentication methods, and port information.

features.name: Table dollar extension removal
features.description: Business Central 29 removes the previous table dollar extension naming convention.

features.name: IIS website publication
features.description: Web client is published as an IIS website under the Inet pub folder with browseable access to the locally installed Business Central version.

features.name: SQL Server 2022 compatibility requirement
features.description: Business Central 29 requires SQL Server 2022 Express or higher as minimum, with support for compatibility levels 160 and 170.
caveats: higher versions like developer or enterprise also supported

features.name: Full-Text Search Requirement
features.description: Full-text and semantic extract extractions for search must be enabled during SQL Server installation as a mandated feature.

features.name: Windows 11 and Windows Server Support
features.description: Business Central requires Windows 11 (Enterprise, Education, Pro editions only) or Windows Server 2022 and 2025 (Data Center and Standard editions).
caveats: Only specific editions supported; installation will fail otherwise

features.name: Minimum CPU and Memory Requirements
features.description: Business Central server requires minimum 4-core CPU and 16-64 GB RAM depending on extension size. Developers need 4-core CPU with RAM based on workload.
caveats: Memory requirement varies with workload and extension size

features.name: Disk Space Requirements
features.description: Business Central server requires approximately 100 GB hard disk space. Developer machines require 500 MB minimum but more is recommended.
caveats: 100 GB is described as sufficient rather than strict minimum

features.name: IIS 10 or Higher Requirement
features.description: Web server installation requires Internet Information Services (IIS) version 10 or higher.

features.name: Mobile App Version Support
features.description: Business Central mobile app requires version 4.0 or later, supporting both Android and iOS platforms, with 7-inch tablet and 4-inch phone minimum screen sizes.
caveats: Screen size requirements vary by device type

features.name: Outlook Integration Requirements
features.description: Outlook integration requires Outlook 2024 or Outlook web version, Exchange Online or Exchange Server 2019, and requires authentication configuration.
caveats: Authentication must be configured with Microsoft Entra ID or NAV username password

features.name: Microsoft Office Component Support
features.description: Excel and Word integration require Office 2024 or later. Excel reporting and Word reporting are optional but require these applications installed.
caveats: Office integration is not mandatory, only required for specific reporting features
